title: Drummers old and new, Jefferson and Alvin Alcorn
summary: Bebop drummers versus old timers, Andrew Jefferson, day jobs, and a trio with Alvin Alcorn.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Music isn't going. Yeah. You mentioned trouble with finding good drummers. Is it harder now to find good drummers than it was in the old days? Yes. Yes, it is. What's the reason for that?

Well, the drummers nowadays like to play with it. Nicely known as bebop. You know what I mean? And some of them start to time and start off slow and you end up fast. You finish the vice versa. Fast and slow. They don't hold. They don't hold. They're big as well. No, not as good as the old timers.
Are there still some good old timers around? Oh, yeah. They've got a few of them.
Well, the one that I especially knew of that's good is Bigard, from the Whirling R.D.M.s along. And Andrew Jefferson, even though they're good drummers.
And he doesn't get too much work around the quarter. Who is that? Jefferson. I've never seen him in a quarter much. Oh, no? I can't understand him. No.
Well, sometimes, you know, we've got a day job. Sometimes the fellows have a day job. I like to be trying to write. I say, for instance, myself, I wouldn't want to take an overnight job. Oh, no.
No. No. Or three, four o'clock in the morning, I get right up and go to a whole day job too.

Some of the best plan I've heard one night was just three pieces. Alvin Alcorn, H.E., Fred and mine, you know, on banjo and guitar, I guess it was. I think banjo. And Andrew Jefferson out of a place called Rue's Tavern here. And they just played for the people dancing. That's some of the best plan I ever heard Alvin Alcorn do, you know. Because it was just him and he could really shine, you know, just a little trumpet. He's a wonderful trumpet player.

Yeah, that's what I'm fixing to say. Now, you take men like that, they really know what they're doing. In other words, they start off a number. The trumpet player especially, they stay in the key and when they play, they know what they're playing. Everybody else, when they play. They take some trumpet players, they just only know what in the world they're playing.
Well, they think there are reasons they are.
